summary: Wrote four plain lines explaining TARZ0-777: a directory of 145 browser games you open in a new tab, some instant and some needing your own game files, with search and filters, and play links that go only to the game.
current_status: TARZ0-777 is a Vite/React catalog of 145 browser games with the pixel hero, colorful sky, and tappable skateboarding dinosaur. No code changes this turn.
